description: We are a multidisciplinary team of developers, designers, and innovators passionate about space exploration, AI, and scientific discovery. We aim to transform NASA’s microgravity combustion research into meaningful, AI-powered fire safety insights for future space missions. We value collaboration, creativity, and technical excellence. We welcome participants with skills in AI/ML, data science, scientific research, UI/UX, and software engineering who are eager to contribute and learn.
